parsed.explanation: Elevated risk. No criminalisation, legal recognition, pride scale, and courts suggest social acceptance, but there are traveler-facing exposures: airport gender-identity screening can out and detain trans travellers, with no regulations at the main international airport; custody defaults to isolation or men’s-prison placement despite some case-based relief; and 2025 reporting shows a pattern of transphobic physical violence including dating-app traps and organized ambushes. Gender-identity recourse is unresolved. These unremedied institutional exposures are lighter than severe-state targeting, but keep the jurisdiction below reduced-risk scores despite functioning rule of law.
